# ENV011: Active virtual environment differs from selected Python

<!-- Code generated by cmd/rulegen from the builtin registry. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Component: python. Severity: warning.

Collector prerequisites: runtimes.

The active environment metadata and the selected Python invocation refer to different environments.

Evidence required: Readable VIRTUAL_ENV pyvenv.cfg/canonical directory and a known selected Python invocation outside that environment.

Manual steps:

- Reactivate the intended virtual environment and check both Python aliases in the current shell.

Verify with `envdoctor diagnose --rule ENV011`.

Limitations:

- Compare canonical environment directories with Windows case and separator normalization.
- A venv symlink to a system interpreter still belongs to its invocation environment.
- Unknown shims, unreadable environment metadata and unresolved interpreters are inconclusive. No interpreter is executed.
- Opaque shims and WindowsApps aliases/protected package paths remain unknown. New snapshots with unknown resolution do not support a runtime conflict.

No command is executed by this rule. Evidence comes only from the snapshot. Failed prerequisite collectors disable the rule. Positive, negative and edge fixtures cover Windows, Linux and macOS; platform exclusions are listed above.

Documentation: <https://github.com/shellghostt/envdoctor/blob/main/docs/rules/ENV011.md>.
